tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss the actual forestry or conservation programme with prospective students and clarify their recruitment, registration and placement questions.
inputs: Actual prospective students and programme information
outputs: Actual student questions, intentions and clarified options

steps.what: Read the actual student requests and records in the student-information workspace, identify the correct student and course identifiers and enter the actual selected request fields for registration preparation.
inputs: Actual student requests from s1
Actual existing student and course records
outputs: Actual selected identifiers and supplied request fields

steps.what: Determine and write the teacher's actual placement recommendation in the registration workspace, considering the student's background, programme requirements and unresolved exceptions.
inputs: Actual student information and request from s1-s2
Actual programme requirements
outputs: Actual human placement recommendation and exception notes

steps.what: Populate the actual draft registration form in the student-information system from the selected student/course fields and the teacher's actual written recommendation using supported native field mapping.
inputs: Actual supplied request fields from s2
Actual recommendation from s3
outputs: Complete draft registration/placement form

steps.what: Check the actual complete registration/placement form for the correct student, course, stated recommendation and unresolved exceptions before passing it to the registrar's existing decision process.
inputs: Complete actual draft form from s4
Actual request and recommendation from s1-s3
outputs: Teacher-checked actual registration form or correction request

steps.what: Save the teacher-checked form in the same student-information workspace without changing official enrollment status.
inputs: Actual checked form from s5
outputs: Saved draft registration form

steps.what: Review the actual completed registration form as the registrar, resolve the actual eligibility and placement exceptions and authorise the final student/course/status version for official registration.
inputs: Actual completed form from s6
Actual student/course requirements and exception evidence
outputs: Final version-specific registration authorisation or unresolved case

steps.what: Commit the actual authorised student/course/status version to the official student registry, only under the registrar's final authorisation from s7.
inputs: Actual final registration form from s6-s7
Current registrar authorisation from s7
outputs: Actual official registration or placement update

tasks.design: For a teacher already helping enter actual registrations, configure native mapping of the selected actual fields into the registration form. OTHER is the existing student-information system. Student identity, field capture, placement judgement, teacher checks and the existing registrar decision remain. Saving a draft is ordinary and ungated; changing official enrollment status is a separate consequential commit. Changed student, course, recommendation or status returns through the checks and s7.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual student/course fields may be re-keyed from the teacher's request workspace into the registration form.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported native field mapping can populate exact draft fields without choosing placement.
tasks.still_hard: Student circumstances and programme exceptions require accountable human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain options and decide what recommendation fits the actual student.

ambition.what: Support the existing actual recruitment and registration activities.

tasks.altitude: Specify reliable student/course identifiers and exception ownership.

evidence.claim: Native field mapping can remove registration-form re-keying while placement decisions and official status authorisation remain human.

assumptions: Conditional baseline has teacher-entered forms and an existing registrar authorisation process; this is not a claim that every teacher controls official registration.
Actual student request and selected field capture are counted in s1-s2; no fresh clean application feed is assumed.
Shares are estimated active-work allocation; eight registrar hours are other-role labour and remain unchanged.
A teacher with outreach-only duties gets no new registration task or saving from this proposal.
unknowns: Actual teacher permissions, registrar process and manual duplicated fields
research_questions: Trace a real teacher-assisted registration and verify which fields are genuinely re-keyed and who authorises official status.

already_counted.description: Actual student discussion, field capture, human recommendation, form check, ordinary draft save and official commit
Existing registrar eligibility and final-version review

incremental.description: Maintain exact field mapping and test student/course identity after changes

approvals.approved_version: Final actual student/course/status form authorised by registrar in s7; changes require s7 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is outreach-only teacher participation or a registry without a compatible duplicate-entry route; no form work is added and no change is deployed. Where actual re-keying exists, the 20-hour exact form-fill step is removed from 92 focal baseline hours, 21.74%, less 2 upkeep hours per 100 focal baseline hours. Eight registrar hours and the actual commit remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain teaching materials and supplies

steps.what: Select the actual textbooks and laboratory equipment needed for the forestry or conservation course, considering learning outcomes and actual field/laboratory methods.
inputs: Actual course outcomes and teaching methods
outputs: Actual materials and technical requirements

steps.what: Check the actual available books, equipment condition and quantities before requesting additional supplies.
inputs: Actual requirements from s1
Actual existing teaching materials and equipment
outputs: Actual shortages and usable existing materials

steps.what: Examine actual catalogue editions, equipment specifications, availability and quotations to select the actual supplier items that meet the teaching need.
inputs: Actual shortages from s2
Actual supplier catalogue and quotations
outputs: Actual selected item identifiers, quantities and quoted terms

steps.what: Prepare the actual requisition/order draft in {PROCUREMENT}, using native catalogue selection for item descriptions, quoted unit prices and the established delivery address while entering actual quantities and course justification.
inputs: Actual selected items, quantities and quotations from s3
Actual established delivery address and course need
outputs: Complete actual draft order/requisition

steps.what: Check the completed actual requisition for textbook edition, equipment compatibility, quantities, price and course justification, correcting unsuitable selections before existing budget review.
inputs: Complete actual order draft from s4
Actual teaching and quotation requirements from s1-s3
outputs: Teacher-checked actual order version

steps.what: Review the actual completed order as the department budget approver and authorise its final items, quantities, amount, delivery address and supplier under the existing purchasing process.
inputs: Actual teacher-checked order from s5
Actual department budget and purchasing requirements
outputs: Final version-and-supplier order authorisation or rejection

steps.what: Send the actual final order to the supplier through {PROCUREMENT}, only for the version and supplier authorised in s6.
inputs: Final actual order from s5-s6
Current supplier/version authorisation from s6
outputs: Actual supplier order

steps.what: Receive and check the actual delivered materials and equipment against the actual order, resolving the wrong edition, damage or missing items when they occur.
inputs: Actual delivery after s7
Actual supplier order
outputs: Actual obtained teaching materials and receipt findings

steps.what: Enter the actual received quantities and any discrepancy in the existing {PROCUREMENT} receipt record after checking the actual delivery.
inputs: Actual receipt findings from s8
outputs: Actual receipt/discrepancy entry

tasks.design: Use native catalogue selection only for actual repeated order fields. Keep educational selection, physical stock checks, actual supplier comparison, technical checks, existing budget review and actual receipt. The receipt entry follows the real delivery, and no completion is posted in advance. The separate supplier send requires authorisation of its final version; changed items, price, address or supplier return to the actual checks and s6.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected catalogue descriptions, quoted prices and delivery details may be typed repeatedly into a requisition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procurement catalogue fields can supply those exact repeated values.
tasks.still_hard: A catalogue match may be the wrong edition or incompatible instrument for the course.
tasks.human_edge: Judge educational and practical suitability and examine the actual goods.

ambition.what: Obtain the actual selected teaching supplies.

tasks.altitude: Specify educational and compatibility requirements before ordering.

evidence.claim: Native procurement catalogues can populate exact order fields while suitability, budget review and receipt remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional baseline already uses a purchasing and receipt process with the stated budget approver; no new approval or receipt report is added.
Only 35% of s4 is repeated descriptions, unit prices and delivery fields; actual quantities, justification and repair remain.
Supplier quotations and delivery are existing supplier work, unchanged by this field reuse; no supplier saving is claimed.
Shares estimate active purchasing-cycle labour, not delivery waiting time.
unknowns: Actual catalogue coverage, teacher purchasing rights and current field reuse
research_questions: Trace an actual textbook/equipment order and separate repeated catalogue fields from technical selection and approval.

already_counted.description: Actual educational selection, stock check, supplier comparison, retained order entry, technical check, send, receipt and actual receipt entry

incremental.description: Maintain actual delivery/catalogue defaults and check price-field behaviour

approvals.approved_version: Final actual order items, amount, address and supplier authorised in s6; changes require s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is specialist equipment outside the native catalogue or a process already filling these fields; manual entry remains and no change is adopted. In a compatible actual order, remove 5.25 hours repeated entry from 92 focal baseline hours, 5.71%, less 1 upkeep hour per 100 focal baseline hours. All technical, budget and receipt work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Read the actual committee agenda, institutional policy proposals and departmental or academic evidence relevant to the forestry/conservation programme.
inputs: Actual agenda and current committee papers
outputs: Actual understood policy and academic issues

steps.what: Prepare the teacher's actual written comments or policy amendments in {DOCS} where the committee requests them; the native comment format supplies repeated agenda-item headings and source-document links only.
inputs: Actual issues and papers from s1
Actual teacher's policy judgement and committee comment format
outputs: Actual written committee contribution linked to the agenda item

steps.what: Serve on the actual academic or administrative committee through discussion, challenge, deliberation and any actual vote on institutional policy, departmental matters or academic issues.
inputs: Actual papers from s1
Actual written contribution from s2 where requested
Actual committee members' views
outputs: Actual deliberation, recommendations and committee decisions

tasks.design: Keep actual policy judgement and committee deliberation. For a real requested written contribution, reuse only agenda headings and exact source links. Ordinary comment writing and its save stay within the same working document without a self-approval gate. Do not assign secretarial minutes, a new post-meeting action log or a publication duty to a committee member who does not perform them.
tasks.previous_blocker: A requested written comment may repeat agenda titles and document references.
tasks.enabler_now: A native comment template can supply those exact structural fields.
tasks.still_hard: Academic policy choices require weighing competing interests and actual evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge proposals and negotiate practical departmental decisions.

ambition.what: Make the existing actual committee contribution.

tasks.altitude: Distinguish the evidence and trade-offs behind a policy decision.

evidence.claim: A native comment format can reuse exact headings and source links without deciding the policy comment.

assumptions: Conditional workflow includes an actually requested written contribution; it is not a new requirement for a member who only reads and participates.
Only 10% of that contribution step is repeated headings/links; all substantive writing and ordinary document retention remain.
No committee secretary labour or separate minutes saving is claimed.
Shares are estimated active contribution-cycle labour, not measured committee time.
unknowns: Whether actual written comments are requested and whether headings are already supplied
research_questions: Inspect a real committee contribution and determine whether manual agenda/source repetition exists.

already_counted.description: Actual papers review, substantive written contribution and actual committee deliberation

incremental.description: Keep the actual agenda/source-link comment format current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has no requested written contribution, or already supplies its agenda headings and links; no additional record is introduced and no change is claimed. With real manual repetition, remove 2.5 hours of structural entry, less 0.5 hour upkeep. Actual reading, policy writing, discussion and decisions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read and critically review the actual colleague or journal manuscript, assessing forestry/conservation questions, methods, evidence and interpretation.
inputs: Actual manuscript supplied by colleague or journal
outputs: Actual scientific review judgements and manuscript-specific concerns

steps.what: Check the actual relevant references, methods detail and numerical or logical concerns needed to substantiate the scientific review, resolving uncertainty from the actual manuscript and available sources.
inputs: Actual concerns from s1
Actual manuscript details and genuine references
outputs: Actual substantiated review findings and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write the actual scientific review in {DOCS}, including the reviewer judgement and manuscript-specific comments; a native local review template supplies only the fixed review headings.
inputs: Actual substantiated findings from s1-s2
Actual required review headings
outputs: Complete actual draft scientific review

steps.what: Check the completed actual review for scientific accuracy, confidentiality, intended colleague/editor recipient and distinction between evidence and recommendation, authorising that final version for transmission.
inputs: Complete actual review from s3
Actual manuscript and substantiated findings from s1-s2
outputs: Final scientific review and version/recipient send authorisation

steps.what: Save the actual final review in the same permitted {DOCS} working file.
inputs: Final review from s4
outputs: Saved actual final review

steps.what: Send the actual final scientific review through the existing journal review portal or agreed colleague channel, only for the version and recipient authorised in s4.
inputs: Saved actual final review from s5
Current send authorisation from s4
outputs: Actual review delivered to the intended editor or colleague

tasks.design: Use a local native heading template for the existing review, with no model upload or generated scientific judgement. OTHER is the existing journal review portal or agreed colleague delivery channel. Keep actual manuscript reading, verification, new review prose and final checks. The ordinary save is ungated and fully retained; the real review send is separate. Any content or recipient change returns to s4.
tasks.previous_blocker: A reviewer may manually reproduce the same required headings in an otherwise new scientific review.
tasks.enabler_now: A local native template can supply those headings without using manuscript content in a model.
tasks.still_hard: The validity, novelty and fairness of the scientific criticism require expert review.
tasks.human_edge: Give justified, constructive criticism and own the recommendation.

ambition.what: Complete the existing actual scientific review.

tasks.altitude: Maintain a clear standard for substantiated scientific criticism.

evidence.claim: A local native review-heading template can remove repeated structural typing without evaluating a confidential manuscript.

assumptions: The existing review is written and delivered; no extra review record or automated recommendation is added.
Only 5% of the review-writing step is fixed headings, not 5% of all scientific review effort.
All genuine verification and manuscript-specific prose stay human; shares are unmeasured estimates.
Where the journal form already supplies headings, this change has no benefit.
unknowns: Actual journal heading format and current template use
research_questions: Inspect an actual review and identify whether any repeated heading typing exists outside the journal form.

already_counted.description: Actual manuscript review, verification, substantive writing, final review check, ordinary save and real send

incremental.description: Maintain the small local heading template when review requirements change

approvals.approved_version: Final actual scientific review and intended recipient checked in s4; changes require s4 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is a journal form already supplying headings or a one-off colleague review without fixed headings; no new format is introduced. Where the actual headings are manually repeated, remove 0.75 hour per 100 from writing, less 0.2 hour upkeep. All actual scientific evaluation, new prose and the small save/send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specify exact registration and purchasing data while retaining student guidance, educational choices, institutional judgement and scientific review.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who removes proven form re-keying and repeated structural text while keeping actual students, teaching suitability and academic decisions central.

job.title: Forestry and Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary
